assessment: This manuscript provides important structural insights into the recognition and degradation of the host tRNA methyltransferase TRMT1 by SARS-CoV-2 protease nsp5 (Mpro). The data provide compelling support for the main conclusions of the authors. These results will be of interest to researchers studying structures, substrate recognition and specificity of viral proteases and their action on cellular targets.
